import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class DS {
        int[] parent;
        int[] cont;
        int cc;

        public DS(int n) {
            parent = new int[n];
            cont = new int[n];
            cc = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                parent[i] = i;
                cont[i] = 1;
            }
        }

        int SetOf(int x) {
            if (parent[x] == x) {
                return x;
            }
            parent[x] = SetOf(parent[x]);
            return parent[x];
        }

        boolean Merge(int x, int y) {
            x = SetOf(x);
            y = SetOf(y);
            if (x == y) {
                return false;
            }
            if (cont[x] > cont[y]) {
                int temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }

            if (cont[x] == 1 && cont[y] == 1) {
                cc++;
            }
            if (cont[x] > 1 && cont[y] > 1) {
                cc--;
            }

            parent[x] = y;
            cont[y] += cont[x];
            return true;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        final int mod = 1000000007;

        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        long ans = 1;

        if (k == 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < p - 1; i++) {
                ans = (ans * p) % mod;
            }
        } else {
            int cc = p;
            DS ds = new DS(p);
            for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
                int toMerge = (int)((long)k * i % p);
                if (ds.Merge(i, toMerge)) {
                    cc--;
                }
            }
            if (k > 1) {
                cc = ds.cc;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < cc; i++) {
                ans = (ans * p) % mod;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
